external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing group that maintains the catalogue spreadsheet.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
external_entities.notes: The text names Marketing as a group rather than an individual actor.

external_entities.name: Fax gateway
external_entities.description: An external gateway that faxes dispatch confirmations to customers.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and place orders and which talks to the web API.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app;

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app, which keeps customer information and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is unspecified: 'Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication'.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: Spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unspecified: 'Nobody here can tell me ... whether the user database ... [is] encrypted'.

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file containing only delivery addresses for orders.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else —
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unspecified: 'Nobody here can tell me ... whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted'.

data_stores.name: Catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet containing the marketing catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and order requests to the web API through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app;

data_flows.name: talk to API
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS, it's on the list.

data_flows.name: hand over order
data_flows.description: The web API hands a placed order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes a confirmation containing the customer's name and address to the customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it.
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: confirmation with customer name and address

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: The spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: Office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop hosting the catalogue spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.
trust_boundaries.notes: This is the only explicitly described location or zone.

assumptions.assumption: The web API is internet-facing because Sokify sells socks online and customers use it to browse and order.
assumptions.basis: The source says 'Sokify sells socks online' and that customers browse and order through the mobile app.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains 'name, address, and the card they paid with'.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains customer delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses.
